claims.claim: Judge Noël Wise denied Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron's motion to dismiss a DRAM antitrust complaint on November 14.
claims.episode_span: On November 14, U.S. District Judge Noël Wise of the Northern District of California denied a joint motion to dismiss
claims.source_title: Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron Fail to Get DRAM Antitrust Suit Dismissed
claims.supporting_quote: On November 14, U.S. District Judge Noël Wise of the Northern District of California denied the three companies' joint motion to dismiss, finding the complaint plausibly alleges an agreement in violation of Section 1 of the Sherman Act.

claims.claim: The complaint alleges conventional DRAM prices rose 697 percent over 18 months and that the three firms held over 91 percent of global DRAM revenue as of the third quarter of 2025.
claims.episode_span: conventional DRAM prices rose 697 percent over 18 months
claims.source_title: Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron Fail to Get DRAM Antitrust Suit Dismissed
claims.supporting_quote: The suit, filed in June by 17 consumers and small businesses, claims the trio, which held over 91% of global DRAM revenue as of Q3 2025, coordinated production cuts starting in late 2022 and shifted capacity toward HBM while conventional DRAM prices rose 697% over 18 months.
